description: This file defines an asynchronous function 'waitForAbortSignal' that waits for an AbortSignal to be aborted. It registers an event listener to resolve a promise once the 'abort' event is triggered, or immediately returns if the signal is already aborted or undefined.

methods.name: export async function waitForAbortSignal(signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<void> { waitForAbortSignal
methods.description: Asynchronously waits for an optional AbortSignal to be aborted. Resolves immediately if the signal is undefined or already aborted; otherwise attaches an event listener to resolve once the signal is aborted.
